excerpt: Per Point: five surface buildings, "about 20000 m2, including 3300 m2 of buildings"; a cluster of SD, SU and SE buildings at the head of the shaft, stand-alone SF and SHM; PM shaft 9.7 m diameter, 80 m high; service cavern 16 m diameter, 45 m long; UR gallery 300 m.
title: Civil engineering for the High-Luminosity LHC (J. L. Tavian, P. Mattelaer), CERN Accelerating News issue 20
